raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly hypothesized that the "orchestral country pop ballad" directed by Yoann Lemoine was by Taylor Swift (specifically "Safe & Sound"). This hypothesis was flawed from the start because "Safe & Sound" was directed by Roman White, not Yoann Lemoine. While the Planner later corrected course after WebSurfer provided evidence, the initial error in forming the hypothesis led to a significant portion of the conversation being wasted verifying a false premise (Taylor Swift) before eventually identifying the correct artist (Harry Styles) based on the "Sign of the Times" video.
